summary: Keep Git and publication clean across autonomous tasks
description: Connect serial campaign transitions to existing verified publisher and cleanup, including changed remote bases and checkpoint-only commits, without making unrelated work wait for one final batch release. Scope and mandate: .go/plans/autonomy-first.json. Reuse released ABC/advice/readiness behavior; implement only this delta.
acceptance: Each independently shippable release-required task performs scoped commit/push, required tag/release/deployment and exact remote/live readback before done. Honor explicit no-release policies; do not invent targets, repeat a deployment or wait for unrelated research.

One release owner retains durable intent/reservation until verified readback or proven safe abort. Lost acknowledgements trigger observation before retry; unknown effects block the publication channel.

Preserve unrelated dirt, local saves, unregistered branches/worktrees and restricted local artifacts. Stage only owned changes, retain recoverable work, and verify cleanup/remote parity without force-reset, broad git add or force-push.

Distinguish product revisions from workflow/checkpoint commits; metadata-only closure must not redeploy. A remote/base advance requires controlled reconciliation and fresh applicable evidence, with conflict repair bounded by scope.
Expose exact remaining Git/release blockers to the campaign; a task completed locally but not delivered must never be reported live.

Complete this independently shippable stack change with content-bound checks/critic, scoped commit/push, immutable release and remote readback; preserve user dirt and historical evidence. Current request authorizes planning only; no execution or publication starts during intake.
